# llm-retry-fallback

> Retries with capped exponential backoff and full jitter, RFC 9110 Retry-After parsing, an overall deadline and ordered provider fallback, all clock-injected Python package `trysac-llm-retry-fallback`, import name `llm_retry_fallback`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
